SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-04: FHIRPath — §5.2 Filtering and Projection. Test these items: where(criteria), select(projection), repeat(projection), ofType(type). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.evidence: Spec requires the ofType type argument to resolve to a model type. Native DuckDB returns fhirpath_is_valid=true for entry.resource.ofType(NotAType).id when the validation sample makes the source path empty, while forced Python fallback returns false. Probe: .temp/qa/fp04_skeptic_probe.py; log: .temp/qa/fp04_skeptic_probe.log.
issues.root_cause: Native evalOfType validated the target type only by calling fn_isType for each input item. When fhirpath_is_valid() evaluated against its sparse Patient validation resource and the ofType source path was empty, the input loop never ran and unknown type specifiers were masked as valid.
issues.resolution: Validate the resolved ofType type specifier once before iterating input in extensions/fhirpath/src/fhirpath/evaluator.cpp. Added native SQL and DuckDB native-vs-forced-fallback regression coverage for unknown ofType specifiers on empty source paths.
